description: This file is a Java source code file containing a helper class `GlobalConfigurationHelper` for managing global configurations in the Apache Fineract integration tests. It provides methods for retrieving, resetting, verifying, and updating global configuration properties via API calls, utilizing various models and utility classes.

classes.name: GlobalConfigurationHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing and verifying global configuration properties in Fineract integration tests.

methods.name: getAllGlobalConfigurations
methods.description: Retrieves all global configuration settings from the Fineract server.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationByName
methods.description: Retrieves a specific global configuration property by its name.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific global configuration property by its ID.

methods.name: resetAllDefaultGlobalConfigurations
methods.description: Resets all global configurations to their default values.

methods.name: isMatching
methods.description: Checks if a configuration obtained from API matches the default configuration in terms of name, value, enabled state, and trapDoor flag.

methods.name: verifyAllDefaultGlobalConfigurations
methods.description: Verifies that all current global configurations match the expected default values.

methods.name: getAllDefaultGlobalConfigurations
methods.description: Provides a list of default global configuration properties for the system.

methods.name: updateGlobalConfiguration
methods.description: Updates a global configuration by its name with the provided request data.

methods.name: updateGlobalConfigurationInternal
methods.description: Internally updates a global configuration's value directly.

methods.name: manageConfigurations
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific global configuration property.
